title: a signed literal is a number; a negated name stays an expression
note: FIXED 2026-09-03. `-2.50` was stored as the string "-2.50" because the sign is a unary operator over an unsigned NUMBER terminal, so `attrs.value = -2.5` queries found nothing and the export type differed from `2.50`. The mapper now folds a sign on a bare number to the number and keeps the lexeme in `valueText`; `-x` stays an expression string, and `-3` on a Natural is the ordinary value-type-mismatch. This fixture records the diagnostic shape of the case (it produced the same warning before the fix); the fold itself is pinned by `test/unit/text.literal-form.test.ts`.
